description: This file defines an Android foreground service named NodeForegroundService that manages a persistent connection to a node, showing connection status via notifications, and handling start/stop commands. It manages notification channels, updates notifications based on runtime status, and integrates with coroutine flows for asynchronous updates.

classes.name: NodeForegroundService
classes.description: An Android foreground service that maintains a persistent connection to a node, displaying status via notifications and handling control intents.

classes.name: Quint
classes.description: A data class used to hold multiple status text values for notification updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, creates notification channel, builds initial notification, retrieves runtime, and sets up status update coroutine.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles start commands; stops service if ACTION_STOP is received, otherwise keeps service running.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cancels ongoing coroutine jobs and scope, then cleans up service.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as this is a started service, not a bound service.

methods.name: ensureChannel
methods.description: Creates notification channel for connection status updates.

methods.name: buildNotification
methods.description: Builds a notification with given title and text, including actions for launching app and disconnecting.

methods.name: updateNotification
methods.description: Updates existing notification with new notification content.

methods.name: startForegroundWithTypes
methods.description: Starts the service in the foreground with a notification, or updates existing notification.
